note: Plan 0009, PT-68 town_views and PT-69 town_budget: the four views of the town (R6). The eye is a point in degrees (lat, lon) at eye_height over the ground; heading in degrees from the north to the east; pitch in degrees up; fov the vertical field of view of the game for the frame of the photo. A view with a photo has the place and the direction of that photo (the camera place of the file, else the place that the photo shows). tools/town/sheets.py puts each view next to its photo.

views.name: The top of Núi Nhỏ, at the lighthouse
views.eye_note: The gallery of the lighthouse (the photo is from it; the ground at its foot has trees round it).

photos.author: Damian Vo
photos.shows: The town from the gallery of the lighthouse on Núi Nhỏ, looking north-east: roofs below, Bàu Sen lake, the twin towers, the coast of Bãi Sau, and the hills of Long Hải far away.
photos.title: View of Vung Tau from Vung Tau lighthouse (August 3, 2018) (43913500872).jpg
photos.place: the lighthouse (the geotag of the file is in the town, 1 km north: not used)
photos.direction: north-east, 53 degrees (the near twin towers and Bàu Sen)

compare.how: Report 0009, D-0009-15: the town between the trees of the hill and the sea, in the frame and in the photo. The limits are builder values: the mean value within 0.08 of the photo, and at most 10 points more of near white pixels.

views.how: Report 0009, D-0009-18: from the photo (4:3; a phone of 26 mm in 35 mm: 67.3 by 53.1 degrees). The near twin towers (85 m and 87 m of the 2.5D data, about 1 km away, bearings 68.7 and 71.7 degrees) are at x 0.73 of the photo: the heading is 53.1 degrees. With it, Bàu Sen (bearing 47 degrees) is 6 degrees left of the middle, as in the photo. The pair of 90 m and 91 m 2.4 km away (bearing 33 degrees) is the small pair far left in the photo. The horizon is at y 0.27: the pitch is -12.9 degrees.

towers.how: Report 0009, D-0009-24: the lit fronts of six towers of the photo (the twin towers, and four towers left and right of them; the boxes are fractions of the photo), against the buildings of 25 m or more in the frame nearer than 3 km. The limits are builder values.

views.name: The cable car of Núi Lớn, over Bạch Dinh
views.eye_note: Report 0009, D-0009-18: the photo is from the cable car over Bạch Dinh, so the eye is on the line of the cable car of OpenStreetMap (way 236681315), 241 m west of Bạch Dinh, at 66.2 m over the mean sea level.

photos.author: Luci nguyễn
photos.shows: From the cable car on the south-west side of Núi Lớn, looking south-east: Bạch Dinh below, Trần Phú road, the bay of Bãi Trước with boats, and Núi Nhỏ at the end of the bay.

views.how: From the photo (16:9; a phone: 71.9 by 44.4 degrees): Bạch Dinh is at x 0.33, y 0.57, the lighthouse on Núi Nhỏ at x 0.46, and the horizon at y 0.36. On the line of the cable car, the point where the lighthouse is 10.5 degrees right of Bạch Dinh is the eye; the heading puts the lighthouse at x 0.46 (153.6 degrees), the horizon gives the pitch (-6.5 degrees), and Bạch Dinh 9.8 degrees under the horizon gives the height (its roof about 8 m over its base).

views.name: The Hải Đăng road
views.eye_note: The point of the Hải Đăng road nearest to the geotag of the photo (12 m from it: the geotag is on a lot beside the road, where a building stands), 1 m over the highest tree of the canopy map within 8 m (as PT-33): the photo is from the railing, over the tree tops of the slope below the road.

photos.author: Han Minh Chu
photos.shows: The whole town from the Hải Đăng road over the trees, looking north to north-north-east: far hills on the left and the water of Bãi Sau on the far right.

views.how: Report 0009, D-0009-18: from the photo (Nokia Lumia 1020 in the file, 4:3 at 26 mm in 35 mm: 67.3 by 53.1 degrees). The pair of towers at x 0.645 is the pair of 90 m and 91 m (bearing 44 degrees): the heading is 33 degrees, so Núi Lớn (341 degrees) is out of the frame and the water of Bãi Sau is on the right, as in the photo. The horizon is at y 0.615: the pitch is +6.6 degrees.
